# Test discovery

When validating this project with pytest, begin at the repository root and use the project's test command. If pytest exits 5 with `no tests ran` from `tools/`, check the current working directory before treating it as a test failure.
- [Test discovery](test-discovery.md): Run pytest from the repository root; `tools/` can collect no tests.
